response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong technical leadership and versatility across multiple domains, including event-driven systems, distributed architectures, and AI-agent infrastructure. However, his experience is heavily weighted toward general software engineering and web/mobile development rather than the specific fintech and agentic-AI requirements. While he has exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP, frameworks), there is no evidence of production experience in regulated fintech environments or large-scale agentic systems operating under real-time financial constraints. His leadership experience is notable but lacks the scale-up mentality and fintech-specific domain expertise required.
strengths: Proven track record in scaling engineering teams and organizations (e.g., Optilyz, re:cinq)
Strong distributed-systems expertise with event-driven architectures and microservices (Dunnhumby, GISCollective)
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and tooling (MCP, Model Context Protocol)
concerns: Limited direct experience with agentic-AI systems in production, particularly in fintech or high-stakes commercial environments
No visible track record in fintech infrastructure (credit systems, real-time risk assessment, or payment flows)
Lacks evidence of operating AI systems under regulatory or compliance constraints (e.g., auditable, debuggable agent behavior)
